Given,

Now let $g\left(x\right) = 6{x}^{2} - 18x + 17$

Now we will find minimum value of $g\left(x\right)$ by differentiating it we get,

${g}^{'}\left(x\right) = 12x - 18$

Now putting the minimum value of $g\left(x\right)$ in $f\left(x\right)$ we get,

Now on comparing with given data in question we get, $m = \dfrac{15}{7} \text{ and } n = 1$
